entity: STATE OF SOUTH CAROLINA THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
stance_basis: letter explicitly states no comments to offer on the EIS, only noting procedural status
summary: The South Carolina Public Service Commission submitted a brief letter stating that Duke Power Company had not yet applied for a certificate under the state's Utility Facility Siting and Environmental Protection Act, and therefore the Commission had no comments to offer on the Federal Power Commission's Environmental Impact Statement. The Commission noted it was monitoring Duke's load growth plans and offered to share Duke's application upon receipt, but took no substantive position on the project itself.
complaint_summary: The South Carolina Public Service Commission states it has no comments on the EIS because Duke Power has not yet applied for a state certificate, but notes it is closely monitoring Duke's load growth plans and will hold a hearing upon receiving Duke's application.

statement.text:
At the present time Duke Power Company has not applied for a certificate under South Carolina's "Utility Facility Siting and Environmental Protection Act", and this Commission has no comments to offer in connection with the Environmental Impact Statement prepared by the Federal Power Commission on the Bad Creek Pumped Storage Facility.
See revised Table 1-1.
On receipt of Duke's Application, a Hearing will be held in accordance with the abovementioned Act, after which a certificate could be issued.
No comment required.
This Commission is looking very closely at the growth of load on the Duke System and Duke's plans for serving that load including reasonable reserves.
No comment required.
Should you desire, we will provide your Commission with a copy of Duke's Application when it is received.
